 Bablu 
 Through: Mr

 versus

 Through: Ms
 Ch
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ravinder Dudeja
 Order

This is an application filed on behalf of the petitioner for the grant of regular bail in case FIR no.
508/2022 under Section 376/506 IPC read with Section 6 of POCSO Act, PS Hari Nagar.
2. After part submissions, the Ld. Counsel seeks permission to withdraw the bail application.
However, he states that applicant is in custody for the last about 3 years and therefore, direction be issued to the Trail Court for expeditious disposal of the case.

3. Ld. APP submits that the trial is at the fag end inasmuch as out of 26 witnesses cited by the prosecution, only the Investigating Officer and the doctor remain to be examined and the next date listed before the Trial Court This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 09/10/2025 at 22:14:05 is 27.10.2025.
4. The statement made by the Ld.
Counsel for the petitioner is taken on record and application is dismissed as withdrawn with direction to the Ld. Trial Court to make best possible endeavour to expeditiously dispose of the case.
5. Copy of this order be sent to the Trial Court for information and compliance.
